hook: Did you know that northern Chile's Atacama Desert turned into a blooming garden in 2026?

sections.voiceover: Did you know that northern Chile's Atacama Desert turned into a blooming garden in 2026?
sections.visual_cue: Wide aerial shot transitioning from barren brown desert to purple flowers.

sections.voiceover: Could this rare event turn the Atacama Desert landscape into shades of red, purple, and white?
sections.visual_cue: Satellite time-lapse footage showing green patches spreading across the desert floor.

sections.voiceover: Yet, these heavy rains caused floods that destroyed dozens of homes and forced hundreds to evacuate.
sections.visual_cue: Ground-level shots of flood-damaged terrain in the Atacama region.

sections.voiceover: NASA Earth Observatory documented this massive flowering event driven by a 2026 El Niño super cycle. NASA Earth Observatory images from November 19, 2026, show the most extensive bloom ever recorded.
sections.visual_cue: Comparison graphic showing Landsat imagery provided by NASA.

sections.voiceover: The NASA Earth Observatory documented this massive flowering event across the Atacama Desert in 2026.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of a single purple desert flower blooming against cracked earth.
